workflow: Each sheet generated fresh, then one simplification edit; final outputs visually inspected. Initial detailed drafts excluded from deliverables.

sheets.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a polished WorldEngine Style B vehicle design sheet, 5 columns by 3 rows, each isolated three-quarter asset on a warm cream background, generously spaced and equally readable. Exact small labels below each: Sedan, SUV, Pickup, Taxi, City bus, School bus, Delivery van, Box truck, Semi, Fire truck, Ambulance, Police, Bicycle, Scooter, E-scooter. Strict rich stylized simple 3D forms, chunky beveled flat-color hard surfaces, dark opaque blue-gray windows, no surface imagery, readable wheels, warm low sun from upper left with cool lavender fill and soft grounded cast shadows, exposure balanced no orange wash. Cream, muted teal, brick red, slate blue; school bus warm ochre; taxi muted gold; emergency vehicles simple red cream navy forms with no lettering, insignia, medical symbol, badge, racing stripes or manufacturer cues. Semi tractor and trailer connected; clear pickup open bed. Calm tasteful detail, no photoreal materials, no logos, no brand design cues, no faces, no scenery. Landscape reference sheet.
sheets.one_edit_prompt: Edit this reference sheet preserving its 15 cells, labels, lighting and class order. Radically simplify all vehicle bodies into WorldEngine strict Style B chunky low-poly game meshes: only a handful of broad beveled body/cabin blocks, simple dark opaque window planes, solid thick wheel cylinders WITHOUT spokes/treads/hubs, flat smooth materials. Remove ALL front grille badges including the oval/circular marks, grille slats, detailed headlights, wipers, handles, mirrors smaller than a thick block, door seam lines, roof racks, ladder rungs, tire texture, chrome and manufacturer-like styling. Each car should resemble a generic deliberately simplified 300–600 triangle game prop, not a miniature realistic car. Calm recolourable clay-like material planes, no texture or photoreal shading. Retain sedan/SUV/open-bed pickup/roof-block taxi/bus/van/box/semi class silhouettes. Emergency forms plain non-livery masses, no stripe on ambulance and no distinctive police two-tone pattern. Keep labels.

sheets.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Polished WorldEngine Style B transport and wildlife design sheet on warm cream backdrop, 4 columns by 4 rows. Exact labels for row1: Elevated rail, Commuter rail, Light rail, Airliner. Row2: Regional jet, Prop plane, Helicopter, Contrail. Row3: Sailboat, Motorboat, Ferry, Cargo ship. Row4: Flying flock, Ducks, Geese, Dog on lead. Each separate 3-quarter simple readable stylized 3D asset, generic unbranded forms, flat solid palettes muted teal cream blue rust, beveled hard surfaces and smooth organics. Warm directional light upper-left and cool lavender fill, consistent soft shadows, no photoreal textures or surface imagery. Rail cars visible articulated/connected proportion, airplanes correct wings/tail silhouettes, translucent restrained contrail, distinct boat scale silhouettes with tiny stylized water patches. Birds wing silhouettes, duck/goose neck distinction. Dog is small generic ambient animal attached by simple visible lead to a faceless simple adult pedestrian; not a hero character. No logos lettering liveries airline cues or identifying features.
sheets.one_edit_prompt: Edit this entire sheet preserving 16-cell order, labels and warm/cool lighting. STRICT WorldEngine Style B tiny game assets made of broad low-detail beveled blocks and smoothly rounded organic shapes, far simpler than now. Remove detailed train fronts/route displays and livery bands, vehicle panel seams, tiny rail cables, airline design cues, landing gear detail, boat railings/windows smaller than broad bands, realistic waves, feather contours, animal faces/eyes, and human facial/profile detail. Ducks and geese must be ON WATER as smooth rounded floating body plus neck/head, short vs long neck; only Flying flock uses airborne birds. Dog smooth generic body and four chunky legs with completely featureless head, plain lead to a faceless smooth adult shape. Flying birds simple broad curved wing/V shapes no individual feathers. Three-quarter forms should be plausible 100–900 triangle stylized props, not detailed illustration. Water one calm flat blue patch, simple tiny wake. Contrail subtle long smooth translucent ribbon, not cloudy dense smoke. Keep class distinctions and labels.

sheets.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. WorldEngine Style B living-layer reference sheet, clear cream layout, 3 rows. Top row four examples: faceless pedestrian, runner, cyclist, small group of three adults. Adults normal proportions but simplified smooth rounded heads without eyes mouths hair identity, muted varied skin/material colors and coats sage ochre rust cream; no realistic details, no children, no branding. Second row show the SAME pedestrian and runner at large, medium and tiny screen scale to demonstrate stripping detail without enlarging the tiny figure. Third row six labeled visual effect mini vignettes: Rain splashes, Snow drift, Blowing leaves, Steam vent, Chimney smoke, Sprinkler. Each simple procedural-looking form over a tiny ground/chimney patch; rain small bright rings/droplets, snow sparse low ribbons, leaves few opaque rust shapes, steam pale small puffs fading, chimney smoke gray gentle wisps upward no fire, sprinkler sparse short arc water over green patch. Rich stylized 3D planes/smooth organics, no photographic textures, warm sun upper-left and cool lavender shadows, readability at phone size, no logos. Labels short and exact. Landscape sheet.
sheets.one_edit_prompt: Edit this sheet keeping layout, labels and coherent lighting. Simplify people to smooth rounded featureless head, torso, arms, legs without folds, hoodie details, bags, hair, shoes laces, realistic anatomy or accessory identity; muted coats are flat solid forms, gently beveled/slightly rounded low-polygon game models. Same people at three scales MUST lose detail: medium simple merged torso and limb shapes; tiny a simple two-color upright silhouette with no fine anatomy. Eliminate brick/paving surface texture, tiny grass blades and detailed vent grille from effect vignettes: use broad smooth planes and a few large procedural forms. Rain splashes only2–3small bright rings with few droplets; snow drift thin low sparse ribbons not piled snow mountain; leaves few opaque simple shapes; steam/smoke tiny pale sparse puffs not thick billowing stacks; sprinkler one short sparse arc not many overlapping particle lines. Strict calm rich stylized WorldEngine forms rather than detailed realistic illustration.
